header.title: Welcome to your dashboard
header.desc: From this bar you can reach notifications and switch dark mode. To find a new space, use “Browse spaces” from the navigation menu.

sidebar.title: Navigate between your tabs
sidebar.desc: Here you move between: Overview, My bookings, Favourite spaces, Special requests, and Settings. Your profile details are at the top.

metrics.title: Your activity metrics
metrics.desc: These four cards summarise your usage: upcoming bookings, hours booked this month, saved spaces, and hours you spent in spaces.

quickAction.title: Quick actions
quickAction.desc: From here you browse spaces and compare prices and internet, or rate your experience. If you need a custom arrangement, create a request from the «Special requests» tab.

assistant.title: Your smart assistant
assistant.desc: Ask about your bookings, favourites and requests and get quick recommendations. You control your data privacy from inside the assistant itself.

overview.heroDescOwner: Track your space bookings and manage availability from here.
overview.heroDescCustomer: Manage your bookings and favourites here — book the right seat quickly and with confidence.

actions.rateDesc: Tell us about the space quality and services

bookings.title: Your upcoming bookings
bookings.emptyDesc: Book your first seat and start working with focus.

rate.title: Rate your last experience
rate.desc: What did you think of the space and the service you booked?
rate.thanksDesc: We recorded your rating of {{rating}} out of 5 stars.
